name: OnyxDAO NFTLiquidation unvalidated repay oToken
summary: NFTLiquidation.liquidateWithSingleRepay accepts any oTokenRepay and sets extraRepayAmount from the caller's repayAmount, which the Comptroller adds to every seize calculation. Having borrowed against flash-loaned oETH and forced a shortfall via oETH redeem rounding, the attacker's fake oToken self-liquidated for 1 wei and seized back its collateral.
notes: The reset points NFTLiquidation at the relaunched Comptroller, where its shortfall check finds the attacker's position (rule 8 controller). The oVUSD listing 10 days earlier only sized the loss: any listed debt market could carry the 1-wei liquidation.

VUSD has no market price; it is valued at what the attacker realised for all of it (rule 12): the in-tx and later Uniswap and CoW sales and the 55.98 ETH and 15,000 USDC borrowed against the last 260,000 VUSD deposited in oVUSD.
Separate incident from the November 2023 Onyx oPEPE rounding exploit (eip155:1:0xf7c21600…): different vulnerability and comptroller. The oETH redeem rounding here only created the shortfall.
